summary: Step machine of a client session unload: created by the unload game state's Enter (bg3.exe+0x18679F0), advanced by the per-frame update of ecl::SessionUnloadSystem (bg3.exe+0x18B4D00, 10 states) which removes the component in the last state.

fields.name: GameState
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1867B70 zeroes; bg3.exe+0x18679F0 stores the game state's this pointer; in state 9 bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 writes 1 to byte +0x28 of the pointed object (marks the state done) before removing the component.

fields.name: Waiting
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes (8-byte store at +8). bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 sets it to 1 after each state step; while 1 it counts FramesWaited and resets to 0 after 5 frames, and the switch on State runs only when it is 0.

fields.name: FramesWaited
fields.evidence: Incremented each frame while Waiting == 1, compared with 5 (bg3.exe+0x18B4D00).

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes (4-byte store at +0x10); bg3.exe+0x18B4D00 switches on it (cases 0..9) and writes the next state as a 4-byte store.

open_questions: Waiting may be a wider enum than a flag (only 0/1 seen).
